competitorWins: EarthCam is the deeper dedicated webcam platform: a large, long-running network of famous scenic and tourist cameras (Times Square is the best-known example), curated channels through EarthCam TV, and professional construction-camera services with managed hardware, archiving and time-lapse for commercial clients. For watching a specific famous place, or for a business that needs a camera installed and managed, EarthCam's camera-specific depth and history beat any generalist globe.
description: EarthCam is a live-webcam network and platform: famous scenic and tourist cameras (such as Times Square), EarthCam TV channels, and paid commercial construction-camera services for businesses. Watching many public cameras is free. WorldEye is complementary for breadth: 76,000+ public cameras browsable on a free 3D globe together with live flights, satellites, ships, weather, earthquakes and wildfires — no signup needed.
